scope: Targeted text/contract review and executed deterministic regressions; not an exhaustive proof or media evaluation.

independent_review.additional_scope: Relevant tests and frozen independent-input, ownership, version and audit requirements.
independent_review.reason: The reviewing agent reported truncated test output and did not claim an observed independent pass.

findings.issue: Request source text could be redefined while preserving source_request_id and source ID.
findings.change: Compare every original request source record; reject redefinition or omission.

findings.issue: Reference permission and original-signal copy prohibition were incorrectly treated as the same use; a mixed-use decision could discard an independent prohibition.

before_observed.scenario: Same audio_content: reference allow + copy forbid.

findings.change: Use-sensitive ordinary conflicts, competition and decision grouping; retain cross-attribute frame-anchor checks.

findings.issue: An exact window identity comparison missed a selected-content copy prohibition overlapping a narrower allowed source window.

before_observed.scenario: Whole selected source copy forbidden; seconds 1–2 of the same source copy allowed.

findings.change: Separate source selection from source-time window intersection; absent window does not narrow the selected content.

findings.issue: A full M2 request incorrectly required M2.1 to duplicate asset_context that it does not read.

before_observed.scenario: Valid M2.1 proposal checked against complete M2 request carrying sibling asset context.

findings.change: Compare only the specific child’s declared read-only projections, while preserving equality checks for genuine reads; document complete parent optional inputs.
